horoscope: A conversation may occur with or about a love interest or partner, dear Aries, but be aware that it can quickly spiral into past patterns of conversing to the point that nothing is actually solved. Or, a conversation with a love from your past might spark up. Either way, feelings are a big theme today, and it's very past-focused. Even if things feel roundabout, it's a necessary process for clarifying where you stand and what you will carry forward into the future. New, perhaps surprising insights into intimate matters can surface now as you review the past, process what it means to you now, and imagine what you'd like to change for the future. You're in a position to play detective and may find clues that give you a new perspective on an old issue. Mental detachment can help you stay objective, but consider that your heart may not be ready for where you're going mentally or conversationally.

Love is in focus today, dear Taurus, but try to avoid the trap of communicating and relating in patterns that no longer serve you well. Staying too rooted in old ways of approaching issues can lead to problems now. Look for better ways to connect so you're learning and reviewing rather than rehashing. Opening your mind to another person's perspective right now broadens your own vision, and you may be looking back on a situation with new eyes and much fondness. If the ball seems to be in the other's court now, recognize that it's not about control or power, it's about sharing the spotlight. Negotiations can figure strongly now, and it's a time for being as fair as you can. Reconnecting with people from your past can be a strong draw, a secret may reveal itself, or you're learning new things about a previous relationship. Distractions and interruptions can make it hard to concentrate at times today, but you may need a break.

This is a time when you're speaking up or speaking out, dear Gemini, as Mercury aligns with retrograde Venus. You may very well see where you stand, but do be aware that underlying matters can complicate what seem to be positive communications. Someone can be taking a keen interest in you, and your personality is shining, although you may be feeling a little detached or undecided. There can be quite a bit of attention directed towards you regardless. As well today, you stand to learn something surprising but useful about the work you do or the people you work with. Past matters or even people have a way of resurfacing now. You can resolve many problems through brainstorming and review, even if there can be more to the story later. You have unique insight into whether your ventures, particularly those related to health or work and daily affairs, are genuinely fulfilling you. Conversations or information coming in today and this week can lead to a reevaluation of these matters.

Conversations today tend to revolve around love, the past, and emotions, dear Cancer, and you can be busy making sense of something. With Venus retrograde, the past is sure to be a big topic now, and this can be an illuminating time. However, you may want to avoid getting too caught up in past behaviors when you are interacting with familiar people. If it didn't work in the past, it's unlikely to work now! You are well-received, however, even if you are a little distant and withdrawn. While your romantic life may be on the tricky side until at least next month, talks and thoughts ensue, and you're drawing some interesting conclusions. Personal fulfillment is a big question with retrograde Venus, and it's a time for reevaluating particular areas of your life, mainly related to creativity, hobbies, romance, and friendship. It's possible you reconnect with an old love or friend, or you may be learning something new about a previous relationship or your feelings.

Conversations and thoughts quite readily turn to the past or areas of emotional dissatisfaction today, dear Leo, and you're inclined to analyze things. Love can be a tricky topic today, but the intentions are good. You stand to gain new insights and awareness that help you better understand and function. You can be paying special attention to unresolved relationship or comfort matters. You're looking at old problems from a new perspective as information comes in or strong memories prompt you to muse about the past. You're inclined to analyze, but it's important to note that your mind may be working much faster than your heart, and you may not be entirely ready for what you're curious about. It's a fine time, however, to consider whether your current living conditions are serving you well.

With today's Mercury-Venus connection, dear Virgo, you may do a lot of analyzing and sorting things out, especially with feelings and affections. You may be making sense of old relationships or reviving old projects and receiving news that prompts a new perspective on a past matter. You can be drawn to a past project or study with renewed interest, or you could discover that a current course of study or venture is no longer fulfilling you. Conversations may revolve around satisfaction levels, love, or complicated social situations. You might learn something new that gives you a little more clarity on a matter that has confused or even haunted you. Still, it's important to note that the picture may not be complete. This is an excellent time to do some redesign or review, although it may be best not to finalize things yet. Even with some speed bumps today, you are magnetic and charming in your communications.

Your ruler, Venus, aligns with Mercury today, dear Libra, and people can be seeking your advice. You're coming across as especially open. However, others can't seem to touch deeper matters with you right now with Venus currently retrograde. There is a hesitancy in you about digging down too deeply or opening up about things that truly matter just for the time being. Personal finances or personal possessions and questions of ownership can become a hot topic today. It's a better time for review than it is for making important decisions about your assets, but don't discard things coming to your attention now! Even if they require further thought or adjustments later, this is a good time for analysis and review. Backtracking can involve going over matters from the past you recently dug up, particularly surrounding love, feelings, pleasure, valuables, and money. You get a second chance or a second look at a project, purchase, or association, and relocating a lost item is not out of the question now.

People can be taking a particular interest in you and could be talking about you quite a bit now, dear Scorpio, with Mercury and retrograde Venus aligned in your sign today. Conversations tend to turn to you, or revolve around you. While you're a little more inclined to express yourself, someone else may be holding something back or hesitant. Alternatively, conversations or meetings turn to unresolved matters, and you get some strong reminders of the past. New information about an old issue can figure strongly now. While it's an excellent time for rethinking and reevaluating personal plans and projects, it's not the time to make final decisions. Instead, it's a better time for entertaining possibilities and keeping plans open since there is likely more to the unfolding story!

More information could surface about a matter that will help you make better decisions about the future, dear Sagittarius. However, it’s best to process and digest things rather than finalize since Venus is retrograde and will continue in this fashion until November 13th. Conversations or musings can help illuminate the past in a meaningful way for you, and the focus is on love, feelings, and relating patterns. While discoveries may be about affections or satisfaction levels, your ability to detach a little from emotions is what benefits you the most for the time being. Keep in mind that your mind is moving much faster than your heart, so you may want to avoid bringing up certain topics until you're truly ready. Still, it can be a busy day for thinking and analyzing. You're inclined to talk about personal matters, although you tend to leave some of the deeper things out.

You might learn something about someone from your past, or a conversation with a friend can quickly turn to the past today, dear Capricorn. With today's Mercury-Venus alignment, as Venus is retrograde, you tend to live in the mind rather than dig deep. This process can be useful to an extent, but do watch for talking ahead of yourself, as your heart may not be ready to talk or know about everything that piques your mind's curiosity! Today's transits can stir up a desire to make sense of certain feelings or relationships, but you may not have the whole story. Take a fresh route to express yourself and interact with others by reviewing matters rather than rehashing them. It's a good time for considering whether you're getting enough pleasure from your social life or current goals and projects.

With Venus retrograde until mid-November, dear Aquarius, you may be dealing with temporary problems with career projects or relationships. Today, complications in your relationships come into stronger focus, but you can approach them in a new way as you perceive them from a different perspective. Keep a safe distance emotionally if needed. Socially, it’s better to keep things light. While you’re giving a lot of thought to your career and the path it’s taking, today is about looking back and analyzing. It can be a fine time to reevaluate your projects and goals. You’re likely to gain some new information about an old matter, and while the picture may not yet be complete, you’re one step closer! Improving the pleasure factor is at the top of your priority list, and ideas coming to you today on this level can be golden.

A new perspective can have you redefining some of your beliefs, ideals, goals, and dreams, dear Pisces. You might see which approaches or expectations you had in the past that sent you down the wrong path. Through conversations or musings, you can gain significant insight into mysteries from your personal history. With Mercury and retrograde Venus aligned today, you may be living in the mind, and temporarily overlooking the emotional side of things as your communications get away from you. Sharing knowledge with someone can be especially rewarding, but it's important to keep conversations light or take extra time to process your feelings before making bigger decisions. With Venus retrograde, there is likely more to the story of your feelings and satisfaction levels, so while your assessments are valid now, things need to evolve further before you truly make sense of them.
